name: v0.9.0
body:
## What's Changed
* site: refresh the release snapshot to v0.8.7 by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/216
* Add a Sponsors section (README + site), starting with Synteq by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/217
* fix(lock): never write plaintext recovery copies for locked notes (#132) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/218
* feat(lock): bind the note id and revision in the envelope (#133) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/219
* feat(lock): keep a key-only session and record rollback revisions (#133) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/221
* feat(lock): index an unlocked note without keeping plaintext on disk (#134) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/222
* feat(lock): lock and unlock notes from the UI (#134) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/223
* feat(lock): re-encrypt on rename and document the threat model (#113) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/224
* test(sync): make the host-down fixture a hanging listener by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/225
* site: add mobile navigation and polish spacing and sponsors by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/226
* fix(ui): do not offer a locked note as a Kanban board by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/227
* test(sync-ui): wait for the restarted Tailscale host by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/229
* Release 0.9.0: per-note encryption by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/228


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/compare/v0.8.7...v0.9.0
